description: Typical Parisian family apartment of 110 m2, located close to all the Olympic sites, will seduce you with its large spaces and charm.Located in a lively shopping area, you can easily get around Paris on foot or by transport: 10-minute walk from the RER Denfert Rochereau (RER), 15-minute walk from Montparnasse train station, close to line 4 and many buses.A card of 10 transport tickets/person will be offered with the apartment!The spaceThe apartment is on three floors, the first level consists of a large living room with a kitchen, bathroom and toilet.On the first floor, a master bedroom with an adjoining shower, a children's bedroom with two beds and a toilet (on this floor a room will be closed off).on the top floor, an office with a double sofa.Guest accessThe apartment is located on the 4th floor without elevator, on a quiet street.Other things to notePets not allowedRegistration details7511411346226
